guide.purpose: Starter guide for a Phaser tilemap workflow.
howThisWorks: The real map JSON should be exported from Tiled, not hand-written.
The tileset PNG contains the actual art; the JSON contains where each tile goes.
In Phaser, load the JSON with tilemapTiledJSON and create a layer from it.
Use a static tile layer for collision, and keep the player as a dynamic Arcade body.
pngSetup: Make one combined PNG tileset that holds all tile variants.
Keep every tile the same size, for example 16x16 or 32x32.
Place the tiles in a clean grid with no overlap or rotation.
Use a transparent PNG so empty pixels stay transparent.
For pixel art, keep the source image at native resolution and let Phaser scale it by whole numbers.
pngOrder: Keep that order consistent with the tile IDs you use in Tiled.
Example: the first tile in the PNG should be the first tile index in the map data.
If you later add more tiles, append them in the same grid order instead of reshuffling the existing ones.

tilemapNotes.collisionSetup: In the starter code, every non-empty tile collides via setCollisionByExclusion([-1]).
